[RDSC.4a.1] The C Rete backend is described by three atom
types — `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode`, and `TerminalNode` — each carrying one node of the
compiled Rete network. Atoms are emitted one per node; the
entire rule network for a bundle is the union of all `AlphaNode`,
`BetaNode`, and `TerminalNode` atoms across all modules.
